title: Nutcracker
summary: Turn a tall wooden soldier with a big head and a tall hat, paint his black boots, white trousers and red coat, then add his eyes and his wide mouth.
howToPlay: Match the figure in the frame.
Drag across each row of wood to set its width.
Tap the bands to paint boots, trousers, coat and hat.
Press Paint face, then tap each glowing mark.
rules: The figure is slim at the legs, widest at the shoulders, narrow at the neck, with a big head and a tall hat.
Shape counts for 55 of the 100 points: how closely each row of the doll matches the lit outline.
The bands count for 25 points: each band must be the right colour.
The finishing touches count for 20 points: tap every glowing mark to paint it.
Three stars for 88 or more, two stars for 65 and one star for 40. Watch and learn paints a whole doll for you.
heritageNote: Nutcrackers are turned and carved wooden figures from the Ore Mountains of Germany. Their hinged jaw cracks nuts, and they are painted as soldiers, kings and other figures in bright coats.
